pkgmetadata.longdescription: PoDoFo is a C++ library to work with the PDF file format. This package provides the 1.x API, which is source-incompatible with the 0.10.x series shipped by ::gentoo. It installs into a private prefix (/usr/include/podofo-1 and /usr/$(get_libdir)/podofo-1) so both slots can be installed at the same time: consumers ported to 1.x, such as app-text/calibre 9.15 and newer, opt in explicitly, while app-office/scribus and kde-misc/krename keep using slot 0.

use.flag: Enable the font search mechanism (PODOFO_WITH_FONTMANAGER), which requires media-libs/fontconfig
